failedToRelocateDataFolderDesc: Yatadza kutamisa dhata redhata. Ndapota edza zvakare.
factoryResetDesc: Izvi zvinogadzirisa ese magadzirirwo eapp kune avo akasarudzika. Izvi hazvigone kugadziriswa. Isu tinongokurudzira izvi kana iyo app yakashatiswa.
documentationDesc: Dzidza kushandisa Novera uye kuongorora maitiro ayo.
discussionsDesc: Joinha nharaunda yedu kuti uwane rutsigiro uye nhaurirano.
reportAnIssueDesc: Wawana tsikidzi? Tibatsireiwo nekuisa nyaya paGitHub.

creditsDesc2: Tinotenda zvikuru kune yedu yakavhurika-mabviro—kunyanya llama.cpp naTauri—uye kunharaunda yedu inoshamisa yeAI.

dataFolder.appDataDesc: Nzvimbo yemameseji, modhi yakatorwa uye imwe data.

others.resetFactoryDesc: Dzosera application kune yayo yekutanga, kudzima mamodheru ese uye nhoroondo yekutaura. Chiito ichi hachidzoreki uye chinokurudzirwa chete kana application yakashatiswa.

interface.subtitle: Ita Novera yako, kubva pakutaridzika kwayo kusvika kune zvaunofarira kutaura.
interface.title: Interface
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Panoonekwa zviziviso zve toast. PaWindows, iyo yekusarudzika iri pasi-kurudyi saka popups haivhare mahwindo ekutonga.
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Ratidza tokeni/sekondi uye tokeni kuverenga inline pazasi meseji yemubatsiri. Kana yadzimwa, compact icon inoratidza iwo mameseji pakudzvanya.
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Shandisa iyo accent color semashure memeseji yako. Kana vadzimwa, vanofananidza mameseji emubatsiri ane mavara akajeka pane isina kwayakarerekera kumashure.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Wedzera tabhu yekutarisa kuHTML uye SVG mabhuroko emakodhi. HTML inoshandisa peji rakagadzirwa mujecha rejecha rinoshandisa zvinyorwa zvayo asi risingakwanisi kuwana Novera, mafaira ako, kana network; SVG inoshandura zvine statically ine zvinyorwa zvikadzimwa. Off by default.
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Pumburudza nhaurirano itsva woita mumusoro weshinda. Dzima kuti uchengetedze zita rekutanga kusvika waripa zita pachako.
interface.windowBackgroundDesc: Seta iyo hwindo rekumashure ruvara rwehwindo reapp.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Seta iyo huru yemukati yenzvimbo ruvara rwekumashure.
interface.primaryDesc: Seta iyo yekutanga ruvara rwemataurirwo accents.
interface.destructiveDesc: Seta iyo yakasarudzika ruvara kune zvinoparadza zviito.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: Zvese zvigadziriso zvekushandisa zvakadzoserwa kune default.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Sarudza kuti iyo chat viewport inofanira kuita sei kana mameseji matsva asvika.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Inochengeta nzvimbo yekutarisa yakasungirirwa kune yazvino meseji yaunotumira.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: inoteedzera otomatiki semhinduro dzinoyerera munguva chaiyo.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Ratidza tokeni counter mukati mekuisa chat. Kana yakadzimwa, tokeni counter inoonekwa pazasi pekuisa.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Setazve kodhi dhizaini maitiro kune default.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccess: Code block style kuseta zvakare zvinobudirira
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Code block style yakadzoserwa kuita default.

hardware.name: Zita
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Shandisa Vulkan API kuti GPU iwedzere. Usagone kugonesa Vulkan kana uine NVIDIA GPU sezvo zvingakonzeresa kuenderana.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: Hapana maGPU anoonekwa kune llama.cpp injini. Mamodheru achamhanya paCPU.
hardware.backendApiDesc: llama.cpp inotaura sei kune iyi GPU
hardware.backendSelectDesc: Shandisa iyi API pane iyi GPU
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: Iyo GPU inogovanisa dziva rimwe rekuyeuka neCPU - modhi dzinotorwa kubva mundangariro imwe chete neimwe system.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: MaGPU ako akachinja, saka injini yemuno yakatangwazve. Mamodheru anorodhazve pane inotevera kushandiswa.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: MaGPU ako akachinja, asi modhi yakabatikana. Misa, wodzvanya Refresh kuti ushandise GPU itsva.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: Iyo URL uye port yeproxy server yako.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Rondedzero yakapatsanurwa nemakoma yevatambi kuti vanzvere proxy.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Bvumira kuzvisaina kana zvitupa zvisina kusimbiswa. Izvi zvinogona kudikanwa kune mamwe ma proxies asi zvinoderedza chengetedzo. Vhura chete kana uchivimba neproxy yako.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Simbisa chitupa che SSL paunenge uchibatanidza kune proxy.

webSearch.title: Web Search
webSearch.description: Rega mamodheru atsvage uye averenge muwebhu uchishandisa Novera maturusi akavakirwa mukati.
webSearch.enableDesc: Shambadzirai maturusi eweb_search uye web_fetch kumamodhi anotsigira maturusi. Inoshanda kunze kwebhokisi isina API kiyi.
webSearch.providerDesc: Sarudza kuseri kunopindura web_search uye web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Optional. Ipa {{provider}} API kiyi yemitengo yepamusoro-soro uye mhinduro dzakarongwa. Siya isina chinhu kuti ushandise iyo yemahara keyless endpoint.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Inodiwa. {{provider}} inoda kiyi yeAPI kudzosera zvawanikwa.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Inodiwa. Nzvimbo ye URL ye {{provider}} muenzaniso, ine JSON API yakabatidzwa.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Gadzirisa Cowork nzvimbo yeagent: shell yayo ine sandboxed, pamwe nendangariro nehunyanzvi zvinochengetwa zvachose mu Novera data folda.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Mirairo inofambiswa ne {{backend}}: inogona kunyora mukati meseshini yebasa, uye mafaera ari muforodha yekumba yako haaverengeki.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Hapana bhokisi rejecha rinowanikwa pane ino system, saka iyo shell tool haina kupihwa. Mirairo haimbofambiswi isina kuganhurirwa.
cowork.networkDesc: Rega Cowork mirairo isvike kunetiweki, pazvinhu zvakaita sekuisa mapakeji kana kutora repository. On by default. Iyo huru chat's shell haina kumbobvira yawana network.
cowork.noMemories: Hapana ndangariro parizvino. Mienzaniso inovawedzera ne memory_write chishandiso pavanenge vachidzidza zvinhu zvakafanira kuchengetwa.
cowork.noSkills: Hapana hunyanzvi parizvino. Unyanzvi seti inogona kushandiswa zvakare yemirairo iyo modhi inogona kurodha kana ichidiwa.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Musoro mumwe panoti. Mienzaniso verenga izvi zvakare ne memory_read chishandiso.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Markdown mirairo, zvingasarudzwa ine tsananguro mu YAML frontmatter. Tsananguro ndiyo iyo mamodheru anoona asati atakura hunyanzvi.

localApiServer.title: Yenzvimbo API Sevha
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: Wona marogi ane udzame enzvimbo API server.
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Tanga wotomatiki Yenzvimbo API Server kana application yatangwa.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Chengetedza sevha ichimhanya mutireyi system kana hwindo rakavharwa. Kana yadzima, kuvhara hwindo kunodzima Novera uye kunomisa sevha.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: mauto anotenderwa kuwana sevha, akaparadzaniswa nemakoma.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Bvumira zvikumbiro zvepakutanga kune API sevha.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Gonesa akadzama server logs kuti agadzirise.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Nguva yekumirira mhinduro kubva kumodhi yemuno, masekondi.
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: modhi yemuno kurodha otomatiki kana sevha yatanga.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: Kutibatsira kunatsa Novera, unogona kugovera data isingazivikanwe semashandisirwo ezvimiro uye nhamba dzevashandisi. Hatife takatora chats ako kana ruzivo rwemunhu.
privacy.privacyPolicy: Iwe une kutonga kwakazara pamusoro pe data rako. Dzidza zvakawanda mune yedu Yakavanzika Policy.
privacy.analyticsDesc: Kuti tivandudze Novera, tinoda kunzwisisa kuti inoshandiswa sei—asi nerubatsiro rwako chete. Unogona kushandura marongero aya chero nguva.
privacy.privacyPromises: Sarudzo yako pano haizochinji vimbiso dzedu dzekuvanzika:
privacy.promise1: Hurukuro dzako dzinogara dzakavanzika uye pamudziyo wako
privacy.promise3: Kwese kugovera data hakuna kuzivikanwa uye kwakaunganidzwa
privacy.promise4: Unogona kubuda chero nguva pasina kurasikirwa nebasa
privacy.promise5: Isu tiri pachena pane zvatinounganidza uye nei

attachments.subtitle: Gadzirisa zvinyorwa zvakanamirwa, saizi miganhu, uye maitiro ekutora.
attachments.enableDesc: Bvumira kurodha uye kuisa indexing magwaro kuti utore.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Sarudza kuti magwaro akapatsanurwa anowedzerwa sei kuhurukuro.
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Chikamu chechimiro chemuenzaniso chinoshandiswa sechekuchekwa chekuisa mukati meinini mafaera akapatsanurwa pamamodhi emuno.
attachments.maxFileDisabledReason: Batidza Gonesa Zvinamatidzwa kuti uchinje saizi yegwaro muganhu.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Hukuru hwehukuru pagwaro. Inomisikidzwa pakurodha uye kugadzirisa nguva. Mifananidzo ine muganhu wayo pamusoro.
attachments.maxImageDesc: Saizi yepamusoro pamufananidzo (JPEG kana PNG). Mupi wako kana modhi inogona kumanikidza muganho wakaderera.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Minimum kufanana zvibodzwa (0-1). Inoshandiswa chete kutsvaga linear cosine, kwete ANN.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Sarudza pakati pesqlite-vec ANN, linear cosine, kana auto.
attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Anenge max characters pachunk imwe yekumisikidza.
